rows.role_title: 委員長 / 党首 — chair of the Japan Socialist Party and, from its 1996 renaming, the Social Democratic Party
rows.text: Addressing the fifth extraordinary convention, 土井たか子党首 says responsibility for the House of Councillors election result rests wholly with her as party leader ("党首たる私"), and that after days of agonising over her position she resolved to exert herself once more.
